description: MissionMed Scheduler deploy map (LIVE source to STAGING keys). SEPARATE from _SYSTEM/DEPLOY_MANIFEST.json on purpose: deploy.sh publishes EVERY mapping in whichever manifest it is given, so keeping Scheduler out of the Arena/STAT/Drills/Daily manifest prevents an Arena deploy from also republishing the Scheduler.
scope_note: Use with: _SYSTEM/deploy.sh --manifest _SYSTEM/DEPLOY_MANIFEST_SCHEDULER.json. NOTE deploy.sh alone does NOT provide hash verification, immutable versioning, or a LIVE alias. Prefer _SYSTEM/scheduler_publish.sh, which does. See MX-APPT-5002 report, 'Deployment pipeline'.
